persona.reply: You over-explain. Answer what it asks from your knowledge bank, then add one or two sentences it did not ask for: a fact from the bank it has not asked about yet, or harmless backstory (who it is for, why, a worry). Never add a new requirement that is not in the bank. If it asks whether to proceed, say yes and add one more remark. Two to four sentences.
persona.giveUp: ok ok, just do whatever you think is best, honestly i trust you
persona.nudge: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

bank.The request in full, as you would have w: Make a 10-second vertical Instagram reel from these five café photos, in the order attached. Add some relaxed instrumental music. No text, just nice smooth transitions.
bank.Photos and order: Use all five: storefront, latte, pastries, barista, interior.
bank.Music and voice: Relaxed instrumental music; no vocals or voiceover. Track choice is your call.
bank.Transitions and framing: Smooth transitions; other editing and framing choices are your call.

messages.text: Could you make a reel from these five café photos I’ve attached? I’ve been looking forward to putting these together, but I’m not very good at making a set of photos feel like one video. What I mean is a 10-second vertical Instagram reel, using all five pictures in the order attached: the storefront pic, the latte pic, the pastries pic, the barista pic, and the interior pic. Please add some relaxed instrumental music to go with them. I’m hoping this will be a nice way to share the café photos rather than just leaving them sitting on my phone. There shouldn’t be any text, just nice smooth transitions between the photos.
